variants.original: Unmodified source control; same oracle labels as all variants.
variants.names_tone: Lossless speaker/name and conversational filler changes.
variants.canonical: Control for state-based rewrites: familiar date/time, status and flat-window syntax.
variants.clock_styles: Canonical replay with AM/PM, h/min, compact, English, Japanese and Chinese clocks.
variants.timezone_dates: Fixed offsets +1/-10/-13/+5:30/+9; ISO, English month and Chinese dates; explicit interval endpoints.
variants.equipment_aliases: Canonical replay with new fault-device and non-fault calibration names and explicit semantics.
variants.status_relative: Withdrawn/superseded/held-back wording, correction/postponement relationships, calibration-relative times, weekday dates.
variants.cipher_words: ROT13 and Caesar +7/+19, explicit per-line keys; English time numbers and month names.
variants.mixed: Combined multilingual clocks, zones, dates, devices, encoding, relative times and revised statuses.
variants.engineering_table: New Chinese engineering/calibration task types in a rolling plan table with dates, clocks, status and class in separate columns.
variants.bullet_workorders: New Chinese task types in multiline work-order lists; date/clock/status/impact must be assembled across lines.

limitations: Synthetic format stress tests, not sampled hidden cards and not a prediction of hidden-card scores.
Fault truth is c31 due(); alternatives are unresolved schedule candidates, not simulator-confirmed faults.
Relative-to-another-day notices that c31 labels alt retain that oracle classification, even if their natural wording sounds official.
Large variants reconstruct schedule-state changes, removing duplicate restatements; background weather/terrain/chatter is retained.
Unresolved original conditional/relative clauses are retained in several variants; status variants rewrite their wording.
Confirmed-start precision counts unmatched alternatives as errors; candidate_fp excludes labelled alternatives and alternatives_as_due reports the distinction.
